card.name: Middle digit of years and verse numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a number, either the third digit of a year in a birth-death range or the first digit of a verse number after a chapter colon.

modes.label: Years in life dates
modes.description: The digit right after the leading 1 in a four-digit year, in birth and death dates of historical figures.

modes.label: Bible verse numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a verse number after a chapter and colon, often before a range.
